narrative: 没有时间用推轨。强调本身就是一件武器：一张脸、一把枪、一块标牌。
这一瞬猛推短促到可以被读作一次带有光学拖影的轴向剪辑。急推变焦本身已经很快了，而这个技巧比一次“礼貌”的急推还要快。
如果你能感觉到画面是从容地放大的，那就不是快速变焦。如果机身移动了，那你做的其实是推轨。
how: 锁定的三脚架，或稳固的手持支撑，在极短的瞬间内把变焦推到极限，然后保持画面。从宽景到紧景。
没有视差。提示词：Rapid zoom in on [Subject], faster than a polite crash, almost a cut, the world snapping tight.
when: 当一个信息点必须以猛然一击的方式到来，而不是靠移动抵达时使用。不要在每一句台词上都用它。
vs: 急推变焦（Crash Zoom In）是一次仍能被辨认出是变焦的猛推。快速变焦推近则更接近于一次剪辑。
往复变焦（YoYo Zoom）会再拉回去。而一次真正的剪辑不会留下任何光学拖影。
examples_film: 《热血警探》（Hot Fuzz）把急速变焦当作一种标点符号式的武器来使用。《杀死比尔》（Kill Bill）用急速变焦来制造滑稽或暴力的强调效果。
语法要点：近乎一次剪辑，然后定住画面。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是推轨推进，或者一次缓慢的急推。破绽在于出现了视差，或者画面放大得从容不迫。
解决办法：机身锁定，在几帧之内猛推到紧景，然后保持画面。

faq.q: 电影中的快速变焦推近（Rapid Zoom In）是什么？
faq.a: 快速变焦推近是一次极快的光学猛推，近乎一次剪辑，随后画面定住。摄影机机身保持不动。

faq.q: 快速变焦推近（Rapid Zoom In）与急推变焦（Crash Zoom In）的区别
faq.a: 急推变焦是一次快速但仍可辨认的猛推。快速变焦推近则比“礼貌”的急推更快，更接近于一次带光学拖影的剪辑。

faq.q: 什么时候该用快速变焦推近（Rapid Zoom In）？
faq.a: 当没有时间用推轨、信息点必须猛然收紧时使用。不要在每一句台词上都用它。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写快速变焦推近（Rapid Zoom In）的提示词？
faq.a: 写明一次极快的变焦，随后保持画面。示例：Rapid zoom in on [Subject], faster than a polite crash, almost a cut, the world snapping tight.

narrative: No time for a dolly. Emphasis as a weapon: a face, a gun, a sign.
The snap is so short it can read as an axial cut with a trail of glass. A crash zoom is already fast; this is faster than a polite crash.
If you can feel a leisurely enlarge, it is not rapid. If the body moved, you dollied.
how: Locked sticks or a locked handheld brace, zoom thrown to the end stop in a fraction of a second, then hold. Wide to tight.
No parallax. Prompt: Rapid zoom in on [Subject], faster than a polite crash, almost a cut, the world snapping tight.
when: Use it when a fact must arrive as a snap, not a walk. Do not use it on every line.
vs: Crash Zoom In is the punch that is still readable as a zoom. Rapid is nearer a cut.
YoYo Zoom comes back out. A true cut would have no optical trail.
examples_film: Hot Fuzz weaponizes snap zooms as punctuation. Kill Bill uses snap zooms as comic and violent emphasis.
Grammar: almost a cut, then a hold.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a dolly-in or a slow crash. The tell: parallax, or a leisurely enlarge.
The fix: locked body, snap to tight in a few frames, hold.

faq.q: What is Rapid Zoom In in film?
faq.a: A rapid zoom in is an extremely fast optical snap into the subject, almost a cut, then a hold. The camera body stays put.

faq.q: Rapid Zoom In vs Crash Zoom In
faq.a: A crash zoom in is a fast but readable punch. Rapid zoom in is faster than a polite crash, nearer to a cut with a trail of glass.

faq.q: When should I use Rapid Zoom In?
faq.a: Use it when there is no time for a dolly and the fact must snap tight. Do not use it on every line.

faq.q: How do I prompt Rapid Zoom In for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write an extremely fast zoom, then a hold. Example: Rapid zoom in on [Subject], faster than a polite crash, almost a cut, the world snapping tight.
